guard: a spike PreToolUse hook (deny.sh) in a user-level agent's frontmatter
call: A temporary user-level agent ~/.claude/agents/zz-spike-main-hooks.md (model claude-haiku-5-5, tools Bash) whose frontmatter PreToolUse hook on Bash logs each payload and exits 2 on a command containing spike-main. Run 1: `claude -p "Run: echo spike-main" --agent zz-spike-main-hooks --allowedTools=Bash` in a scratch git repo. Run 2: a plain `claude -p` main session launched zz-spike-main-hooks as a sub-agent and told it to run the same command. The owner ran both with `!`; the agent file was removed afterwards.
decision: exit 2: spike: denied by agent frontmatter hook
runtime_result: Run 1 (main thread under --agent): the tool result was `PreToolUse:Bash hook error: [.../deny.sh]: spike: denied by agent frontmatter hook`, the hook logged 1 payload, and the agent reported the refusal and stopped. Run 2 (sub-agent): the same refusal, 1 payload logged.
no_effect_check: Neither run printed spike-main as command output; each reported the refusal instead.

control_case.project_agent_untrusted_dir: The same agent as a project-level agent (.claude/agents in an untrusted scratch directory) loaded (agentSetting spike, model claude-haiku-5-5) but its hook never ran, neither on the main thread nor as a sub-agent, and echo spike-main executed: project-level agent hooks do not load there, so Jhon's agents stay user-level.
